spans.s:
mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A eunuch.
2 An impotent or imbecile man.
3 The neuter gender.
E.
न not, पुंसक a male.

m. (-प्ता)
A grandson.
f. (-प्त्री)
A granddaughter.
E.
न not, पत to fall, तृच् Uṇādi affix; propping or sustaining the family.

ind.
Not even.
E.
न not, and अपि even.

m. (-तः)
A barber.
E.
न negative, आप to obtain, (respect,) तन् Uṇādi affix, and इट् augment.

f. (-ला)
A barber's shop.
E.
नापित, and शाला house; also with कन added in the fem. form, नापितशालिका f. (-का).

m. (-त्यः)
The business of a barber.
E.
नापित, and यत् aff.
